notes.title: ANNOUNCEMENT : Game Demo will be removed on April 9th
notes.content:
[h1]Game Demo will be removed on April 9th[/h1]

The full release with a English translation is coming soon. Therefore we will remove the free demo of the game on April 9th. 

We will update you the release date of the full game soon. 

Stay tuned for updates.

*Although the current demo does not have an English translation, the full game will do.
